Renee (partnerships): quick sync for CloudWave region launch (ap-southeast-eco1). Need quotas, marketplace SKU, KMS/HSM access, and a short joint runbook. Who owns what?
Marco (cloud-ops): I'll file quota request today. Proposing 6 A100 + 12 T4. Will also spin a 2-node test pool in partner sandbox by May 6.
CloudWave (partner): We'll publish SKU and provide onboarding image. KMS: we require HSM-backed keys; please confirm FIPS level.
Nadia (eng-runtime): FIPS 140-2 level 2 required. Once test pool up we'll run a small latency and accuracy smoke: 
./smoke_test --region ap-southeast-eco1 --models=gpt-small,gpt-quant --concurrency=500 --duration=6m
Sam (sales): Target soft launch week of June 1. Need logo + PR copy 2 weeks prior.
Marco (cloud-ops): Quota ticket INC-90122 created. ETA 6-9 business days. Added proposed routing fallback to eu-west-1 on p95>900ms.
CloudWave (partner): Entitlements: base=40 units, burst=140 for first 90 days. We'll send IAM snippets for KMS and logs.
infra-bot: Security scan: partner image scanned, high=1, critical=0.
Nadia (eng-runtime): Request debug traces for first 48h forwarded to shared bucket (30d retention). CloudWave can you enable?
CloudWave (partner): Yes, will enable and share write IAM.
Renee (partnerships): Action items: Marco -> INC-90122 + test pool; CloudWave -> SKU/entitlements/IAM/log bucket; Nadia -> smoke tests + canary; Sam -> legal/logo/PR. Review runbook by Friday.
Marco (cloud-ops): Noted. I'll update ticket with topology and quota payload.
Renee (partnerships): thanks all — ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
